decisions.reason: As a small accessory with limited visible commitment compared with the trailer lines, it is easier for management to discontinue without admitting a major strategic mistake.
A box car trailer series shown on the home page suggests meaningful investment and public commitment in a core product area, which escalation of commitment makes management reluctant to reverse.
The car transporter trailer likely required real development effort and fits the firm’s trailer know-how, so despite its lower visibility management would still tend to give it more time.
A home-page-promoted low-bed trailer series is a visible and strategically central launch, making management likely to persist unless failure is unmistakable.
The high trailer cover series was publicly featured and complements the established trailer business, so sunk costs and portfolio fit favor retention.
Like the other prominently marketed trailer series, this box car trailer line appears tied to core capabilities and public commitments that management will be inclined to defend.
